component.name: multiflexi-tui
component.summary: Turbo Vision TUI for MultiFlexi CLI

description.p: MultiFlexi TUI is a Turbo Vision terminal front-end for multiflexi-cli. Browse and edit companies, applications, run templates, jobs, credentials and more; run activation and credential wizards; follow live job output; and use admin helpers such as encryption status and prune. Lists support filtering and an active company scope; forms offer relation pickers for foreign keys.
